hermeticity.method: I first formed focus-only models from وَإِنَّهُۥ عَلَىٰ ذَٰلِكَ لَشَهِيدٌۭ and the complete ش ه د branch inventory, then admitted the context cues one ayah at a time in packet order and recorded only mechanisms that changed a reading still anchored in شَهِيدٌ or its construction.
hermeticity.limitations: This is a reconstructed one-call trace because focus and context arrived together in one sealed packet, not a strict staged blind-reveal log. No source beyond the assigned prompt, schema, and packet was used; contextual arrows and causal directions identified as inferences are supplied by the reader rather than by the packet.

baseline_models.mechanism: The witness is present with the matter and sees it directly. Its force comes from participation or immediate observation, not from receiving a report.

changed_reading.before: Witnesshood is an observer's report about a transition.
changed_reading.after: The transition emits or brings along its own verifying traces; emergence itself arrives with a witness.

surprising_valid_outliers.rendering_caution: This is a deliberately contained material analogy. Do not equate resurrection or inward disclosure with birth, and do not promote root_000822/B006 over the ordinary witness branches.

discarded_or_unchanged: The justice/choice image in وَسَطْ (root_001646/B001) did not alter شَهِيدٌ without importing an unsupported adjudicative scene, so the spatial middle image carried the retained model.

The blackening and ash images in ضَبْحًا (root_000901/B004 and root_000901/B005) repeated the fire-and-residue field but did not produce a changed reading distinct from CTX-02-elicited-latent-sign or CTX-03-forensic-wake.
Proper-name, animal-name, and unrelated botanical images produced no mechanism that returned to a word, root, form, or construction in 100:7.
Morning through root_000839/B001 sharpened visibility but did not independently alter witnesshood outside the larger 100:3-100:4 forensic sequence.

strongest_changes: شَهِيدٌ moved from a conscious observer-speaker to self-generated evidence: panting, altered matter, residue, attachment, and conduct can all testify.
The immediate 100:6 relation revised the focus into self-indictment: a perceiving recipient's severance from nurture is itself evidence of ingratitude.
100:9-100:10 added temporal latency and extraction: witness-status can persist while buried or inward, then become public through uncovering and consolidation.
100:11 differentiated human-scale self-witness from the Lord's knowledge of both report and inward reality, preserving nested epistemic levels.
summary.what_was_special: The focus root's sign, tongue, comb, and emergence branches let one short predicate support several coexisting mechanisms: direct presence, articulate testimony, involuntary expression, forensic trace, inner archive, and material containment. The packet's non-dominant mappings added a live cumulative-pattern reading rather than noise, while the strongest contextual shift made the subject not merely a witness who speaks but a bearer whose body, habits, desire, surroundings, and interior can speak.
remaining_uncertainties: The exact antecedent of the pronoun and scope of ذَٰلِكَ are not fixed by the focus alone; context strongly weights the human and the 100:6 condition but does not make every alternative formally impossible.
It remains open whether self-witness is conscious acknowledgement, involuntary embodied disclosure, an external forensic sign, or several of these at once.
The present predicate may describe evidence already legible or evidence only later exposed by the events of 100:9-100:10.
The counted-recurrence, sterile-spark, comb, and emergence readings are packet-anchored analogical activations, not proposed lexical replacements for شَهِيدٌ.
